login.title: Sign in to YouTube Music
login.note: A separate browser window opens. Sign in to Google there, and close that window once YouTube Music shows your account.
login.noteMac: A separate browser window opens. Sign in to Google there, and quit that browser (⌘Q) once YouTube Music shows your account.
login.noBrowser: Signing in to YouTube Music needs Chrome (Beta, Dev or Canary also work), Edge, Chromium, Brave or Helium installed. On Windows, a portable Chrome, Edge or Brave set as the default browser also works (chrome.exe, msedge.exe or brave.exe itself, not a launcher).
login.unfinished: Sign in before closing the browser
